newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Ralco debuts at 8.50 ringgit.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Ralco debuts at 8.50 ringgit.

text.p: Malaysian plastics manufacturer Ralco Corporation Bhd's shares opened on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE) on Thursday at 8.50 ringgit versus a 2.10 ringgit offer price.
The stock was trading at 8.15 ringgit at 0135 GMT.
Ralco makes and sells blow-moulded plastic products, specifically "jerricans".
The public issue constitutes 4.14 million new shares, and have been listed on the KLSE's Second Board.
Ralco's net earnings for the financial year ended December 31, 1995 stood at 4.07 million ringgit, on a turnover of 25.45 million ringgit.
The company has forecasted it will earn net profit of 5.03 million ringgit in 1996.
The debut price of 8.50 ringgit amounts to a premium of around 290 percent.
